checks.check: enumeration lists the main frame first and one bounded child

realms enumerate with their frame and world
frame and realm ids are disjoint across targets
a snapshot without a frame observes the main frame and names frame, realm and generation
a child-frame snapshot observes the child document
another target's frame and an unknown frame are the same not_found
a realm that is not the frame's live realm is not_found with realm scope
a target-owned capability allows a frame-narrowed snapshot
a frame or realm named as owner is refused
another target's capability cannot reach this target's frame
CDP frame tree has the same shape as the native enumeration

another target's CDP session sees different frame ids
a link click is a same-frame navigation

a node reference from before the navigation is stale_revision

the ended child frame is not_found with frame scope
the new document is observable through the surviving frame

a CDP handle from before the navigation fails typed
CDP re-observes the new document
a second navigation mints a third realm on the same frame

closing the targets leaves zero frames and realms

host exits cleanly
